page_title: LUT 2-1 CRY | Luton v Crystal Palace 25/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+14' The match has just finished.

90+14' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Sam Johnstone makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the bottom left corner.

90+13' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the left post!
90+13' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
90+12' The referee gives a yellow card to Thomas Kaminski (Luton).
90+10' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box found Michael Olise (Crystal Palace), whose header floated just over the bar.
90+9' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.

90+7' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Crystal Palace are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
90+1' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
90+1' The corner is swung in but Crystal Palace can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90' The fourth official shows 12 min. of added time.

90' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders. The ball goes behind for a corner. Crystal Palace will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

88' A dangerous looking corner kick from Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) is cleared to safety by the defence. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Crystal Palace will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

87' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but Thomas Kaminski pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick.
87' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Crystal Palace.

87' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball goes out of play. Crystal Palace are awarded a corner kick.
84' 2 - 1 Goal - 2:1! Chiedozie Ogbene tees up Jacob Brown (Luton) inside the box and he rolls the ball past Sam Johnstone.
80' Roy Hodgson has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) replacing Odsonne Edouard.
80' Here comes a substitution. Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace) is brought on as a substitute for Jeffrey Schlupp.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alfie Doughty leaves the pitch and Jacob Brown (Luton) comes on.

78' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and produces a low shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
77' Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.

74' 1 - 1 Goal! Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the top left corner. Thomas Kaminski had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:1.
74' Substitution. Elijah Adebayo (Luton) has come on for Carlton Morris.
72' 1 - 0 Teden Mengi (Luton) receives a cross from the corner kick and sends a shot towards the goal. His effort finds its way behind the helpless goalkeeper and into the bottom left corner.
72' Alfie Doughty (Luton) will take the corner.
72' Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Luton will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
69' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Crystal Palace due to a handball in the build-up play.
69' The yellow card goes to Jordan Clark (Luton).
69' The Crystal Palace players halt their celebrations as referee Jarred Gillett makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
67' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) beats the offside trap and bears down on goal. With just the keeper to beat he coolly shoots past him from the edge of the box.
64' Alfie Doughty (Luton) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
61' Rob Edwards has decided to substitute Andros Townsend and he is replaced by Tahith Chong (Luton).
61' The manager makes a subsitution with Jordan Clark (Luton) coming on for Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu.
59' Ross Barkley (Luton) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
58' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Alfie Doughty (Luton). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

58' Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Luton have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
57' Amari'i Bell (Luton) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
54' Cheick Doucoure (Crystal Palace) is being substituted because of an injury. Roy Hodgson sends Will Hughes on the pitch.
52' Cheick Doucoure (Crystal Palace) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee decides to stop play.
50' Gabriel Osho (Luton) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
49' Problems for Roy Hodgson as Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Jordan Ayew replaces him.
48' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Jarred Gillett has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but Thomas Kaminski dives superbly to deny him. His shot went towards the left side of the goal.
44' Crystal Palace earn a free kick.
44' Tom Lockyer (Luton) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
43' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
42' Luton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Luton.

41' Luton slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
36' A lofted cross from Tom Lockyer (Luton) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
33' Amari'i Bell (Luton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.

29' Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a low shot from long range which went towards the middle of the goal, but Sam Johnstone was ready and made a save.
29' The free kick is delivered by Alfie Doughty (Luton) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
28' Cheick Doucoure (Crystal Palace) brings an opponent down and Jarred Gillett interrupts the game. Luton have a free kick.
26' Ross Barkley (Luton) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

25' Alfie Doughty (Luton) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Luton have been awarded a corner kick.

23' Thomas Kaminski makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of inside the right post.
21' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
17' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Alfie Doughty (Luton), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
13' This is a yellow card! Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
12' Wonderful movement by Crystal Palace. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
9' Andros Townsend (Luton) sends a cross into the box, but Sam Johnstone comes off his line to gather the ball.
6' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Thomas Kaminski.
4' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
4' Carlton Morris (Luton) commits a foul and Jarred Gillett immediately signals a free kick.
1' So close! Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Luton will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Jarred Gillett.
